question: Should the fail-closed validation-command grammar, explicit non-live proof-subsumption mechanism, and strict server-side base-binding requirement become the permanent repair merge boundary?
rationale: These choices deliberately govern cross-repository command execution, intentional proof omission, credential trust, and when automated repair merges stop despite otherwise passing checks, so technical correctness cannot substitute for owner intent.

options.title: Approve guarded rollout
options.body: Merge the green head and require focused tests and security review for every future supported command form or proof-subsumption contract.

options.title: Disable subsumption initially
options.body: Land staged proof and strict base binding while leaving repository-profile proof subsumption unused pending separate approval.

options.title: Split the boundaries
options.body: Land deterministic staging first and review command grammar, subsumption, and merge authorization in narrower follow-up changes.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded rollout
recommendation.body: Merge the green head and require focused tests and security review for every future supported command form or proof-subsumption contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest historical ownership of the existing repair validation and automated merge contract that this PR changes.
